newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KAISERSLAUTERN BACK IN TOP FLIGHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KAISERSLAUTERN BACK IN TOP FLIGHT.

text.p: Germany's 1991 champions Kaiserslautern ensured on Sunday they bounced back to the first division after just one season in the second, sealing promotion with a 7-0 drubbing of Luebeck.
The result was a triumph for coach Otto Rehhagel, dumped by Bayern Munich last year after less than a season in charge.
Rehhagel persuaded the southwestern side's best players, including Czech international Pavel Kuka and ex-Germany defender Andy Brehme, to stay after relegation last season.
He has taken them back to the top flight with four matches to spare.
